{{Quote|This is Rescue Leader. We've got your signature and are falling into formation behind you, now.| Rescue Leader to [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] while aboard ''Rescue 1''|<ref name="Starfighter" />}}
'''Rescue Leader''' was the callsign of the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Rescue Flight]].

==History==
[[File:Naboo Rescue Boats.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Rescue Flight during the Invasion of Naboo]]
During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|occupation of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> a [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] using the callsign Rescue Leader led Rescue Flight in an [[Raid on the Solleu River|operation]] to free prisoners from a [[Trade Federation prison camp|Federation prison camp]] on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]]. In [[Rescue 1 (Naboo)|''Rescue 1'']], Rescue Leader freed the prisoners from [[Camp Three (Naboo)/Legends|Camp Three]], with [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] providing air support. After rendezvousing with [[Rescue 2 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 2'']], and [[Rescue 3 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 3'']], Rescue Leader led the three to the [[Europa Islands]]. There, ''Rescue 1'' transferred its passengers to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]''.<ref name="Starfighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rescue Leader appeared in the [[2001]] video game [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']], voiced by [[Carlos Alazraqui]].<ref name="Starfighter" />
